main_text.p: guendum; Nam vt Spiritus Dei imple-uit Bezalielem ad excogitandum quic-quid fabrifieri poteft, ex auro, argento & æræ: ita Spiritus nequam, huius æ-ui carnifices edocuit noua plane & i naudita tormentorum genera.

Non mihi si centum linguæ sint,
Oraque centum, Ferrea vox, —
Omnia pœnarum percurrere nomina possem.

[Ligabantur, includebantur, cædebantur, torquebantur, vrebantur, laniabantur, trucidabantur, multiplicabantur, non pugnantes pro salute, sed salutem contemnentes, pro seruatore] vt apposite & verè de horum temporum angustiis loquens {h}D.Augustinus; quibus adijcere liceret, à Ciuilibus commercijs arcebantur, aqua & igne interdicebantur, contra ius fasque ad fodinas & metalla & seruilia opera in Thermis Diocletianis struendis amandabantur, & denique Thermis consumptis, omnes operarij Christiani ad numerum decem millium ducentorum & trium, extra Vrbem ad aquas Saluias necabantur; & alio tempore Nicomediæ viginti milliaDe Ciuit. De Lib.22. cap.6.

page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment ("guendum;"), continued from the previous page. "i naudita" is printed with a space, as printed. Hyphenated line-ends are kept as printed. The verse is set in italics. The left-margin note carries reference mark h.
